## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fe59df0bce3265232f9864cf8efa4e648453f554`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts, ui/packages/auth/src/refusal-text.ts, ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx, ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signInRefusalMessages.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts, ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ResetPasswordPage.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/SetPasswordPage.tsx, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{ar,de,en,es,fr,ja,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hans,zh-Hant}.ts, ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/managedRefusalEnvelope-34171.test.ts, ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/passwordDoorRefusal-34171.test.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/passwordDoorRefusal-34171.test.tsx + read, not reviewed: .changeset/34171-managed-password-refusal-copy.md
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: none
Regen-provenance: none

First record on this head. Inputs: card #34171, claim 7217934544, claim revision 7218058235, dev reports 7218033222 and 7219295017, the PR body, `git diff origin/main...fe59df0b` (merge-base `43ce7311`), and the check-runs on this head. Read outside the diff, not reviewed: plugin-auth `cloud-managed.ts`, `sso-only-local-password.ts`, `pending-sso-marker.ts`, `auth-manager-before-hook.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts` (the set-initial-password route), and cloud `packages/objectos-runtime/src/hosted-local-password.ts`. Nothing was built or run.

The committed tree touches no published schema (`packages/spec/src/**`) and no governed rule text, and the declaration reads `Clause-②: no`. As declared, the diff owes no L2. S1 below would change that.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`toAuthError`, flat first.** A better-auth flat refusal is unchanged.
  - `message`: `error.message ?? envelope.message ?? fallback ?? status line`. A flat message still wins.
  - `code`: `error.code || envelope.code`. A flat code still wins.
  - `userMessage` and `details`: `flat ?? envelope`, then the same string and plain-object guards as before.
  - `status` and `dependents` are read from the flat body only, as before.
  - The one changed order: an envelope message now comes before a caller's `fallbackMessage`. This reaches all 24 callers, not only the four doors. An organization call that got an ADR-0112 envelope used to show its fallback ("Failed to list organizations") and now shows the envelope's message and code. That is the direction #4474 set, and no consumer reads those fallback strings.
- **The envelope read is safe on a non-object body.** `isPlainObject(error.error)` refuses a string (`{ error: "invalid_grant" }`), an array and `null`. Only strings are taken for `message` and `code`. `setInitialPassword` accepts the parsed body only when it is a plain object, and its `status` is written after the spread, so a body's own `status` cannot replace the HTTP one.
- **No caller reads the old message text.** `Auth request failed with status` and `Set password failed with status` occur only in `createAuthClient.ts` and the new test. `AuthProvider` rethrows the same error object for all three doors, so the code reaches the pages.
  - `forgotPassword` and `resetPassword`: the message is the same for a flat body. `code`, `status`, `details` and `userMessage` are new on the error.
  - `setInitialPassword`: it used to read `body.error.message` only. A flat `{ message }` body now shows its message, where it showed the status line. The route answers the envelope in every arm, so no real answer changes.
- **The two maps are kept apart correctly.**
  - `signInRefusalMessages` gains `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. It is passed to `LoginForm` (two sites: the submit and the phone code send) and to the console's dev-admin row. On those doors only the hosted relay answers this code: plugin-auth refuses no sign-in door with it. A pending person's session is refused with `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
  - `passwordDoorRefusalMessages` holds one key. It is passed to both forgot-password pages and read by the reset-password and set-password pages. No two-factor sentence can reach a reset door. The map-shape pin holds this.
- **One code, three producers on the reset and set-password doors.** See S2. Besides the cloud-managed refusal, plugin-auth answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` on `reset-password`, `phone-number/reset-password` and `set-initial-password` for an IdP-provisioned user in SSO-only mode and for a pending SSO person. SSO-only mode is a self-hosted setting.
- **i18n parity: holds.** Both keys are in all eleven locale files. zh-Hant matches the generator's output style, and the dev report names the regeneration.
- **`Clause-②: no`: WRONG, see S1.** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so its new `index.ts` export is not a published surface and does not change the answer by itself. `@object-ui/auth` is published, and `ForgotPasswordFormProps`, exported from its `.` entry, gains the optional `errorMessages`. `@object-ui/i18n` gains two keys in every locale it ships.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: RIGHT.** Nothing a metadata author can write changes.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` on `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/console`: right. Under `Metadata-protocol: none` a non-protocol change ships `patch`, widening or not (AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3). The level stays `patch` after S1.
- No BREAKING banner is owed: nothing is removed or renamed. `refusalText` moved between two unexported modules.
- The changeset and the PR body carry the same two declaration lines.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. No relay note is owed.
- File surface against claim revision 7218058235. Outside it: `LoginForm.tsx` (the lookup moved out), the new `refusal-text.ts`, app-shell `index.ts`, the console `ForgotPasswordPage.tsx`, seven more locale files (the revision names four; the parity test needs eleven), and the three call sites in `createAuthClient.ts` beyond the `toAuthError` hunk. The PR body admits the call sites and the locales. The rest is the seat's scope line to write.
- #37433: this diff does not touch `updateUser` or `types.ts`.
- Security: no enforcement changes. The forgot-password sentence is the same for every request on a managed runtime, so it says nothing about any account.
- SQL push-down: nothing in the diff. Nothing to report.
- Main: the head merges without conflict (merge-tree, no checkout).
- The PR is a draft. No auto-merge is armed.
- Check-runs on this head, read at 2026-11-27T13:23:50Z: 56 runs, 20 success, 13 skipped, 23 in progress, none failed.
  - Success so far: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Lint · ESLint, the Type Check families (workspace, source, debt ledger, consumer), TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build UI Deps, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI.
  - Not yet answered: Test UI 1/16 to 16/16, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, and four Lint families (PM dispatch-gates, docs & code guards, repo & tooling, slot lookup & corpus).
  - "All green" is not established on this head.

### Findings

S1 (should-fix): the declaration should read `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, in the changeset, the PR body and the seat's note against the claim.
- `@object-ui/auth` is published, and its `.` entry exports `ForgotPasswordFormProps`, which gains the optional `errorMessages`. `@object-ui/i18n` gains two keys in every shipped locale.
- Same-kind changes declared `yes (widening)` on main: 36290 (optional props and locale keys), 36372, 36374, 35955, 36899, 36070.
- A minority declared `no` for an optional prop (36219, 36459, 36849, 37858). The reading here follows the majority and record 7211486008.
- Effect: the level stays `patch`. A `yes` makes the PR owe L2 by declaration.

S2 (should-fix): the changeset's last paragraph, "Self-hosted deployments never answer this refusal on these doors, so nothing changes there", is not true for the reset and set-password doors.
- `sso-only-local-password.ts` answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` on `set-initial-password`, `reset-password` and `phone-number/reset-password` for an IdP-provisioned user when SSO-only mode is on. `pending-sso-marker.ts` answers it for a pending person in every mode.
- With this diff those pages show the mapped sentence in place of the server's own ("This environment is in SSO-only mode and your account is provisioned by your identity provider ...").
- The mapped sentence is still true for that reader, and it is now localized. So the code can stand.
- Owed: correct that paragraph and the same claim in the PR body, and name the two other producers in the `passwordDoorRefusalMessages` comment. A pin on one of them would hold the decision.
- The card's own Expected line carries the same premise. The seat records the deviation.

N1 (nit): a refusal whose message is the empty string now reaches the page as an empty description on `setInitialPassword`, where the old code fell back to the status line. No producer sends one.

N2 (nit, a card): the profile page's password card (`ProfilePage.tsx`, `PasswordCard`) draws `err.message` raw for `setInitialPassword` and `changePassword`. The relay refuses `change-password` too, so on a hosted runtime that card still shows the server's English sentence. Four client methods also still throw `new Error(error.message ?? ...)` without `toAuthError` (`sendVerificationEmail`, `signOut`, `updateUser` and the social sign-in). Out of this card's scope.

N3 (nit): the PR body says plugin-auth `cloudManagedRefusal` answers the envelope on the reset doors. Those doors throw better-auth's `APIError` in the before hook, a flat body with the code. `cloudManagedRefusal` is the set-initial-password route's. On main the code was dropped there by the call site, not by `toAuthError`. The fix covers both shapes.

N4 (nit): the reset-password page, the set-password page and the dev-admin row look the code up inline and skip the `CODE:cause` key that `refusalText` tries first.

N5 (nit, accepted): `postPhoneNumberEndpoint` still reads the flat body only. The PR's acceptance note covers it.

No must-fix. S1 and S2 are fixes to prose faces and one comment.
